title: I Like Stone That Is Red
body:
# Woah. Do you like stone? It is quite red.
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c7f53813881233ea110e5470601de726cc375f4.png)



[![Modrinth Profile](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-thinking__about-1bd96a?logo=modrinth&logoColor=white&style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/user/thinking_about.)


# I Like Stone That Is Red 
is a modpack that is used to do redstone. pretty obvious, right?
if you like redstone, this is for you. Creating big machines? no hassle, you have litematica. Its a pretty cool modpack.


=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=


It has a ton of mods (I didn't overdo it. Defintely) And I think your computer should be able to handle it. I hope. We can only hope though.

It has quite a few resource packs making detecting and using redstone easier, while also having graphics to make the game better. (Optional though.)



# Warning

There will **NEVER** be a version that goes to 1.21.9! These do not support quite a lot of mods, and so if all you want this modpack to be is resource packs, be my guest.
